name: Nounsvitational Merchandise - Art Contest
content: {"children":[{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"We are thrilled to announce that Nouns Esports will host the Nounsvitational this December, featuring the world’s best Super Smash Bros. players! This prestigious event will utilize a compendium vote-in system where unique pieces of merchandise will be sold in exchange for points. These points will be used to vote in players to attend the event.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"We are excited to offer our community an exclusive opportunity to be part of this compendium. By submitting your art design, you stand a chance to be included in the compendium. Not only will there be individual prizes based on community voting, but selected pieces will also earn 10% of all sales from the merchandise featuring your design.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"By submitting your art piece you grant Nouns the ability to use it across nouns.gg and socials","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Submit your designs now and be a part of the Nounsvitational experience!","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"root","version":1}
